# Decantr Support

Use the channel that matches the shape of the work:

- Quick setup help, showcase feedback, and live community discussion: [Decantr Discord](https://discord.gg/WeDpBd4xFU)
- Bugs and feature requests: [GitHub Issues](https://github.com/decantr-ai/decantr/issues)
- Proposed code or docs changes: [GitHub Pull Requests](https://github.com/decantr-ai/decantr/pulls)
- Security concerns: follow [SECURITY.md](../SECURITY.md)

Discord is intentionally live and lightweight. Durable decisions should land back in GitHub issues, pull requests, or docs.
